author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers questions from Tested members uncleBING0, TheJMReedy and DavidMarden, whom we thank for their support! Adam reflects on hitting a wall during the peak years of MythBusters, the realization that comfort and rest are tools vs. luxuries, and the three practical shifts he made to reset himself. Plus, Adam shares insight on giving yourself grace when breaking old coping mechanisms and gives an update on his 18-year-old dog Maggie!

​​Do you have any tricks to help start creating new healthy habits? Or doing what you know you should be doing more of?
